And then, open the spherical gateway. And then, go to the east. And then, try to go to the north. Once you manage that, go east. With that over with, move south. And then, make an effort to travel south. And then, make an effort to head east. After that, head north. And then, make an attempt to go to the north. Okay, and then, move north. And then, open the portal. After that, make an attempt to go north. If you can get through with that, retrieve the passkey from the floor of the parlor. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
